integration: After room_program_v6.furnish and intake_presentation_v7.decorate, call register_materials(sc), then apply_room_materials(sc).
apply_room_materials automatically registers missing materials and accepts room_id to bind one of the six rooms independently.
Both calls accept manifest as a parsed dictionary or path; paths are resolved against the real project root, not a temporary generator staging root.
Pass routes explicitly or set sc.room_program_routes. No scene files are written by this module.
Persist the returned report at the coordinator-selected report path. It records every binding, source pixel region/hash and protected-data verification.

atlas_allocation.layout: 3 columns by 2 rows; opaque original native PNG; no gutters or baked labels
atlas_allocation.policy: Coordinator supplies exact integer rectangles after viewing original output. All six regions must lie inside the unchanged PNG without overlap. Non-divisible image dimensions require explicit native boundaries; no resizing, recolouring, smoothing or assumed 512px cells.

scope.rooms: Only named room geometry roots for the six rooms; Entry* architectural fixtures; IntakePresentation_<room> descendants.
scope.corridors: Link_<index> and Step_<index> roots, associated gate and trap leaf, use the portal FROM-room family. Cross-family transitions change at destination room boundary. Source rooms outside the six retain original material.
scope.excluded: Other eight maps, other Intake room roots, authored prop atlas materials, pickup visuals, enemies, signs, lens/emissive materials and old global material resource IDs.
scope.mutation: MeshInstance3D.material_override plus runtime-prism metadata/polygon_material only. Geometry, transforms, mesh resources, collision, hit_material and all other metadata remain byte-identical.

sampling.filter: nearest, no mipmaps or cross-cell blend
sampling.density: 64 native source pixels per metre, configurable uniformly in manifest
sampling.projection: World position projected by dominant face normal. Bypasses BoxMesh packed 3x2 UV cells; square texels on floors/walls regardless of mesh dimensions. Original atlas bound to shader with explicit native region; matching AtlasTexture also registered for inspection.
sampling.wrap: fract inside native cell, floor to integer native pixel, sample exact half-pixel centre
sampling.limitations: Dominant-plane seams can occur on diagonal or curved faces; no fabricated normal/relief map. Final density and repetition require ordinary gameplay-distance visual review.

acceptance: Programmatic integrity and sampling checks are evidence only. Coordinator must inspect actual triage, theatre and service views before accepting appearance or expanding rollout.
integration_status: Integrated into actual Main and scoped Intake scene. Coordinator native visual inspection completed; human acceptance pending.
